name: yoga_wellness
archetype: Holistic wellness and yoga studio with online classes and in-person bookings
market: Urban wellness-focused adults 28-50, primarily women, middle-to-high income
density: Very low density, meditative. Large whitespace. Slow, breathing aesthetic. Studio photography with natural light. Classes shown as clean cards. No rush, no urgency CTAs — the UX feels like the practice.
nav_style: Transparent nav that fades to light on scroll. Studio name in a script or thin serif font. Nav: Practice, Schedule, Teachers, Workshops, About. Right: 'Book Class' CTA in a soft terracotta or sage. Cart icon for merchandise.
commercial_model: Class packs, monthly memberships, drop-in rates. Online streaming subscription for at-home practitioners. Workshops and retreats as premium revenue. Wellness products e-shop. Teacher training program as high-ticket item.
color_palette: Warm natural whites (#FAFAF7) and creams (#F5ECD7). Sage green (#88A47C) for primary accents — grounding, natural. Warm sand (#D4B896) for secondary accents. Dusty rose (#C5848A) for special event highlights. Stone grey (#9E9E8E) for text. The palette is earthy, natural, Japanese-inspired in restraint.
typography: Lora or Cormorant Garamond for headings — slow, humanist, meditative serifs. Lato or Hind for body copy — accessible and clean. Class type names in small caps. Price in understated regular weight, not bold. Instructor names in italic.

pages.title: Home
pages.description: Full-screen studio photography hero — morning light, wooden floors, a single plant. Soft headline. Three class types with brief descriptions. This week's schedule preview (3 upcoming classes). Teacher spotlight. Membership CTA — gentle, not pushy.

pages.title: Class Schedule
pages.description: Weekly class schedule as a clean calendar grid. Class cards: time, class name, teacher, duration, level (beginner/all/advanced), available spots, and book button. Filter by class type and teacher. Virtual class toggle.

pages.title: Our Teachers
pages.description: Teacher directory with soft photography. Each teacher: name, certifications, style/specialization, years of practice, brief bio. Upcoming classes with that teacher. Instagram link.

pages.title: Workshops & Retreats
pages.description: Upcoming workshops and retreats. Each event: title, teacher, dates, location or online, what's included, investment (price shown gently as 'Investment: $...'), limited spots counter, registration form.

pages.title: Our Story
pages.description: Studio founding story. Philosophy and values. The physical space description. Community section — student testimonials. Social impact: donation class for charity. FAQ about starting practice. Press mentions.
